fitNote: Fit and priority are our marketing judgment; routes/policies are verified on official sources. Recheck before outreach.

targets.name: MacStories
targets.route: Official team email links on About page
targets.fit: Native Mac workflow, project references and local recognition.
targets.opening: MacStories focuses on detailed app testing; offer the public build, factual limits and a short demo.
targets.policy: Independent review only; the site says it does not do paid reviews. Read recent relevant coverage yourself.

targets.name: The Sweet Setup
targets.route: Contact-page email link or official social account
targets.fit: Keeping creative ideas and project references together.
targets.opening: Lead with one calm capture-to-project workflow rather than the robot alone.
targets.policy: Contact route welcomes feedback/questions; advertising has a separate sponsorship route. No coverage acceptance is assumed.

targets.name: The Mac Observer
targets.route: Contact us form; subject Suggestion for an article
targets.fit: A practical free Mac app with a distinct save/find interaction.
targets.opening: Give the public app link and a concrete local saved-screenshot search example.
targets.policy: Use the general/editorial form rather than advertising unless a paid inquiry is intended.

targets.name: TidBITS
targets.route: Publisher contact on official Contact page
targets.fit: Local Apple-platform utility; needs a clear distinction from a crowded capture category.
targets.opening: PITCH: DaBin - Mac app for saving and searching local captures. Read the publisher's app-pitch article yourself.
targets.policy: No press releases, guest/sponsored posts or link insertions. Send a concise, personally edited pitch; do not claim research you have not done.

targets.name: Created Tech
targets.fit: Design/Apple workflow; current official site includes Figma and image-editing guides.
targets.opening: Offer the fictional Studio Refresh project-reference workflow and real interface views.
targets.policy: Contact form verified. Check current coverage/activity and policy before sending; some visible articles are older. No response or review is assumed.

targets.name: 9to5Mac
targets.route: News Tips email link on official Contact page
targets.fit: Mac app launch and native/local design details.
targets.opening: Lead with the Mac app's concrete capture/search behavior and a downloadable public build.
targets.policy: Use News Tips, not advertising, for an editorial pitch. The form says tips may be published/syndicated; provide only public information.

targets.name: MacRumors
targets.route: Official tips address on About page
targets.fit: Potential small Mac-app roundup or practical software discovery.
targets.opening: Concise facts: free, Apple Silicon/macOS 14+, local saved-content text recognition and desktop drop target.
targets.policy: Official general tips route verified. Interest and coverage are uncertain; avoid a generic oversized press-release attachment.

targets.name: MacSparky / David Sparks
targets.route: To Reach David address on current About page
targets.fit: Practical Apple productivity and keyboard capture/project workflow.
targets.opening: Use a clear subject and one real workflow; do not pitch a podcast guest or paid link deal.
targets.policy: About page provides a general address and warns replies are limited. Sponsorship is separate; listed availability on its sponsorship page may be stale.

targets.name: Better Creating
targets.opening: A design-reference workflow that shows a useful outcome with a small, clearly scoped demo.
targets.policy: The official page offers sponsorship/product features/reviews. Rates and whether coverage is paid must be clarified. No booking or budget is approved by this kit.

targets.name: Jeff Su
targets.route: Start a partnership link on official Partnerships page
targets.fit: Working professionals collecting references and next actions.
targets.opening: A specific save/find workflow; ask for fit, rates, deliverables and measurement if the owner chooses a paid test.
targets.policy: Official route is a partnership intake with scoped rates; do not treat it as guaranteed free editorial coverage.

doNotPitch.name: MacMost
doNotPitch.reason: Official page explicitly rejects product reviews, free products for review and marketing partnerships; its topic form must not be used to ask it to review or link a product.

notIncluded.name: DailyTekk
notIncluded.reason: Official contact page could not be fetched during this check; no route or email is guessed.
